questions.question: What does Jeremiah 51 continue to proclaim?
options: A great famine across the land

questions.question: What did Jeremiah have done with the scroll of judgment against Babylon?
options: Bound a stone to it and threw it into the Euphrates
Read it aloud before the very face of the king of Babylon
Sealed it away in a clay jar for the sake of safekeeping
Burned it up entirely upon the altar of the holy temple
questions.answer: Bound a stone to it and threw it into the Euphrates

questions.question: Jeremiah 51 says Babylon will sink and not rise, because of the disaster God brings upon her.
Thus shall Babylon _____ and rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her.
The LORD of hosts is his name; he is the one who formed all things, and Israel is the tribe of his _____.
